reasoning: Plan32 lines390–417 and Plan33 standalone amendment prospectively authorize exactly one optional internal logProjection computed from the existing authorized journal read. The outward runtimeActivityProjection mapper explicitly omits it; no persistent record, cache, RPC, extra feed read or owner is added.

Thinking keys are JSON tuples of inputId/operationRef/messageRef/block, with complete-over-later-snapshot precedence and original sequence/eventId retention. Child keys add input/operation/child/parent/kind/message/block/tool; the existing child wrapper identity is used, and child content does not enter root text summary.

The original usage/interactions/tools/text/subagents accounting loop is byte-identical. Thinking then top-level unattributed stderr consume only remaining 256 KiB. Their omission sets logProjection.truncated only; genuine original global gaps retain their previous Stats/cost meaning.

Scheduled projection retains original released/terminal decision, text-only summary500, observed-time duration, usage/result fields and stdout512KiB reserve. Sanitized stderr joins original sequence and retains the first16KiB including one fixed warning, using streaming UTF8 decoding to omit an incomplete final code point.

HostScheduledRuns captures cloned original binding/full request/capture plus selected entry, team/owner/principal and profile/base/owner digests before sharing the callback. Each diagnostic asserts writer, active exact entry, Host-not-sealed, immutable selection/request/profile/owner, original Team control revision, retained scheduled recipe/workspace and capturedMcpSourceCurrent; it does not retarget current source or look up Runtime.

The source assertion is called before delivery and again inside the unchanged Runtime process-output fence. The latter retains exact profile/incarnation/binding/config/openFingerprint/allowed-phase/unreleased checks and existing serialized event limits. Ordinary cancellation may observe closing while Host seal, revoked/replaced grant and release refuse. Callback exceptions cannot replace scheduled outcome or cleanup.

Test preservation: runtime-activity is whole-file append; team-activity is one insertion and excludes only generated computedAt when comparing unchanged Stats. Scheduled tests preserve all original cases/assertions, with explicit helper changes: emit factors original push+wake; default cwd/restart behavior remains equivalent; original warning literal becomes an exact shared constant. Added startup/authority/closing/cold/UTF8 and actual finite SDK assertions are source reviewed, not executed here.
